repo_prior_art.cite: No in-catalogue ExactID result gives a common-measurement-noise snapshot stabilizer fiber.

published_prior_art.cite: AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 gives the known-process-noise congruence architecture; QWENDY2025 gives a homogeneous four-covariance procedure, neither gives the unknown-common-E block-Gram fiber.
AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 permits known additive observation covariance subtraction but does not characterize all unknown-common-E compatible continuous-time explanations.
WangEtAl2024 proves three-time-point recovery for supplied homogeneous state covariances, not the claimed three-versus-four frontier with an unknown common additive covariance.
AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 characterizes orthogonal repeated-eigenvalue blocks; residual-rank strata and attained admissible exponential multiplicity are a natural extension.
Drton2009 supplies general tangent-cone asymptotics, not equality between the snapshot moment-map nullity and an orthogonal stabilizer dimension.
AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 has local loss sensitivity and KoltchinskiiLounici2017 has covariance spectral tools; the common-E Krylov/Stein/log propagation is a new combination.
MorimotoKashima2025 proposes an EM-like Schrödinger-bridge fit, not finite-fiber branchwise delta-method inference under unknown common measurement covariance.
AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022, Theorem 2.1 and its known-additive-noise subtraction remark.
HauensteinSottile2012 certifies supplied polynomial-root approximations, not complete stabilizer elimination and filtered branch enumeration.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5 — cyclic perturbation
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated epsilon conditions control Krylov inversion only; add explicit margins keeping the perturbed transition stable and off the principal-log cut, the Stein operator invertible, and the reconstructed covariance in its claimed domain.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 — known-noise reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: After known E is subtracted, Aalto's equations are level-covariance congruences, whereas the current raw fiber remains difference-congruence equations and its E_W≻0 filter rejects the zero residual-noise transformed model.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–3, Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.1; p. 3, Remark 2.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2.1 assumes known process covariance Q; Corollary 2.1 gives three-time-point identification; Remark 2.2 says known additive observation covariance R can be subtracted.

source_verification_receipts.version: npj Systems Biology and Applications 10 (2024), Article 97
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper parameterizes homogeneous supplied covariance congruences and establishes a three-time-point recovery result under generic conditions.
QWENDY uses four covariance matrices satisfying homogeneous congruences, plus four means with a shared affine-load vector, and claims unique recovery under its invertibility and spectral conditions.
The published paper studies identifying continuous-time linear models from equispaced discrete-time observations through matrix-exponential/logarithm alias restrictions.
The paper proposes an EM-like method alternating Schrödinger-bridge trajectory estimation with linear-Gaussian parameter inference from snapshot data.

source_verification_receipts.version: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 38(4), Article 28, 2012
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: alphaCertified applies Smale alpha-theory to certify convergence for square polynomial systems and tests supplied points for real solutions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Proposition 2 with a separately defined known-E compatibility fiber imposing E_W=E (or zero residual covariance after subtraction), then derive Aalto's level-congruence equations exactly.

State a single explicit perturbation radius as the minimum of the Krylov, stability, logarithm-cut, Stein-resolvent, and positivity margins, and distinguish bounds for defined reconstruction from bounds preserving admissibility.
Add a worked correlated non-diagonal common-E example enumerating raw branches, Stein/positivity rejections, and fourth-snapshot Krylov recovery.

recommended_next_step: Revise the perturbation-domain hypotheses and the known-noise sanity reduction, then advance the common-E fiber and snapshot-frontier kernel to Stage 0.
